crash.title: Something broke
crash.body: That shouldn't happen. Reload, and if it keeps happening tell the board.
crash.staleBody: The app updated while you had it open. Reload and you'll be where you were.
crash.offlineBody: This part of the app isn't on your phone yet, and it can't be downloaded without signal. Try again once you have signal.

door.aim: Point at the QR. Nothing to tap.
door.noQueue: This phone can't keep a queue. Reload the app
door.noQueueOffline: No signal and no queue: nothing is being saved. Reload the app
door.heldRefused: couldn't be accepted: not checked in

camera.denied: We can't get at the camera. Allow it in your browser settings — Settings › {{app}} › Camera — and come back, or check people in by name.
camera.missing: This device has no camera. Check people in by name.
camera.failed: The camera wouldn't start. Check people in by name.

door.searchName: Type and they appear. Three letters is enough.
door.nobodyExpected: Nobody has signed up or checked in yet.
door.noMatch: No name like that. Try the surname. If they aren't there, have them ask to join and approve them tomorrow.
door.undone: Undone. {{nombre}} is no longer checked in.
door.undoneQueued: Out of the queue. This check-in hadn't been sent yet.
door.undoFailed: That couldn't be undone. Try again; if it stays like this, {{nombre}} is still checked in.
door.pointsLede: Tick whoever helped and tap the reason. Two taps and done.
door.nobodyHere: Nobody has checked in yet. Points go to people who are already in.
door.pointsUndo: Points land straight away. If you get one wrong, correct it from the person's page under Members: nothing is deleted, the correction is added.
door.rosterRefused: The list came back empty, which is what happens when you no longer have access. Sign in again, and if it stays like this ask somebody on the board.
door.pointsUnavailable: We couldn't read what each reason is worth. Without that the points would be wrong.

inApp.title: Open it in your browser
inApp.ledeInvited: Someone in the group sent you the link. Open it in your phone's browser and you'll sign in with Google there.
inApp.ledeOpen: You arrived without an invitation. Open the link in your phone's browser, sign in with Google and the board will give you access by hand, usually the same day.
inApp.body: You're inside another app's browser (Instagram, Facebook…) and Google doesn't allow signing in from here. Open this link in your phone's browser and you can sign in as usual.
inApp.ios: Tap the three dots or the share icon and choose the option to open it in your browser or in Safari. If you can't find it, copy the link and paste it into Safari.
inApp.androidHint: If it doesn't open, copy the link and paste it into your browser.
inApp.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Press and hold the link below, copy it and paste it into your browser.

invited.title: You're invited
invited.lede: Somebody in the group sent you the link. Sign in with your Google account and you're one of us. No new password.
invited.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. The invitation is what grants access, and the board can cut it off if it leaks.

open.title: Ask to join
open.lede: You got here without an invitation. Sign in with Google and the board will let you in by hand, usually the same day.
open.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. Until you're approved you can see the events, but you can't sign up for them.

app.title: Sign in
app.lede: Sign in with your Google account. If you've already been accepted, that's all; if not, you'll see how it works once you're in.
app.reassurance: We only take your name, email and photo from the account. If you haven't been accepted yet, the board will let you in by hand, usually the same day.
app.hasCodeHint: Type it into the notice at the top once you're in.

invite.label: Invitation
invite.stale: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one in the group, or come in anyway and wait for the board to approve you.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.lede: We sent it to {{email}}. If it isn't there, check spam.
sent.link: Tap the link in the email and you're in.
sent.orCode: Or, if you prefer, type the six-digit code in that same email.
sent.linkOpensSafari: The link opens Safari, and from there you wouldn't end up in here. Type the code and it works first time.

errors.sendFailed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.badCode: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Ask for another.
errors.googleFailed: We couldn't reach Google. Please try again in a moment.

entry.stranded: It looks like you signed in but the session stayed in the browser rather than here. Open the app from Safari, or tell the board and we'll sort it out.
entry.emailFallback: Or, if Google isn't working for you, sign in with your email.

errors.generic: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't get through. Check your signal and try again.
errors.offline: You need to be online for this.
errors.forbidden: That one isn't yours to do.
errors.notAnImage: I can't read that photo. Try another one, or take it with the camera.
errors.notSaved: It couldn't be sent or saved on this phone, so it won't go by itself. Try again when you have signal.
errors.provaFoto: That photo didn't come through properly. Pick it again and send it once more.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a row. Give it a couple of minutes.
errors.behindServer: This isn't available yet: the app was updated before the data. Try again in a little while; if it stays the same, tell the board.
errors.stalled: The connection isn't answering: nothing is getting through. Try again, or find somewhere with better signal.
errors.sessionUnreachable: Without a connection we can't open your session. When the network is back, the app will open by itself.
errors.sendPaused: No connection. It's waiting here and will go out when the network is back: don't close the app.
errors.sendSlow: The connection is very slow: it hasn't arrived yet.
errors.sendOffline: No connection, so it didn't go out. Try again when you have signal.
errors.avisSostre: With what has already been taken from this person this year and what is proposed and still waiting for confirmation, this warning would go over the cap. Turn down a proposal, raise “Most points per year” in The points table, or make it with no points.
errors.avisForaDelCurs: Today falls outside every academic year, and with no year there's no cap to count. Open the year under “The ranking periods”, or log the warning with no points.
errors.avisPropi: Nobody can give, withdraw or edit a warning of their own. Someone else on the board has to do it.
errors.avisValidacioPropia: You proposed this warning: someone else on the board has to confirm it.
errors.avisJaResolt: Someone else on the board has already confirmed or turned it down. Reload the screen to see it.
errors.avisProposat: This warning is still only proposed: it is turned down, not withdrawn.
errors.viatgerInvalid: Something isn't in the right format. Check the fields and try again.

calendar.offerTitle: Want it in your phone's calendar?
calendar.offerBody: With the time, the place and a link back here. It's a file you open once: if we change the time, you'll need to download it again.
calendar.cannotRead: The app can't see your phone's calendar, so it doesn't know whether you added the event: open the downloaded file to do it. If the time changes, download it again and open it.
calendar.failed: We couldn't prepare the file. Try again.

teaser.pushEyebrow: So you don't find out the next day
teaser.pushTitle: Want your phone to tell you?
teaser.pushBody: The good places go in the first hour. One notification, on the day of the reveal, and no others: the comi doesn't send notifications about anything else.
teaser.pushWhenSub: The system prompt comes after this “Yes”.

pushFail.unsupported: This browser doesn't do notifications. On iPhone the app has to be added to the home screen. You'll still find it on Home the day it opens.
pushFail.unconfigured: Phone notifications aren't plugged in yet. You'll find it on Home the day it opens.
pushFail.denied: You said no to notifications, and this page can't ask again. You'll still find it on Home the day it opens.
pushFail.failed: We couldn't turn the phone notification on. You'll still find it on Home the day it opens.

teaser.lead: There's a night on {{when}}. We can't say what it is yet, or where, or how much.
teaser.notifySub: This isn't signing up: there's nothing to sign up to yet. It's telling us to send it to you first.
teaser.notifySubShort: We can't say what it is yet. The day it opens, you'll be among the first to know.
teaser.done_one: Done. You'll know before anybody else.
teaser.done_other: Done. You're one of the {{count}} who will know first.
teaser.doneSub: It'll be at the top of Home the first time you open the app.

event.fullNoQueue: Nobody is waiting yet. Join the list and you're first if somebody drops out.
event.fullWithQueue_one: {{count}} person is waiting. People always drop out.
event.fullWithQueue_other: {{count}} are waiting. People always drop out.

ask.title: Coming? Say so now, even if it's a maybe
ask.full: No places left. You can join the waiting list
ask.yesWarning: If you say yes, your face goes on the list above and everybody sees it.
ask.yesPublic: Your face is on the list above.
ask.privateAnswer: Maybes and can't-makes go to the board only.
ask.queuePrivate: Being on the list doesn't show anywhere. Only the board sees it.
ask.queueWarning: Joining the list doesn't show anywhere. If a place frees up, the board will tell you.
ask.confirmTitle: Want to come? The board hands out the places
ask.requestWarning: Asking isn't having. The board decides, and we tell you in the group.
ask.requestedPrivate: Nobody can see that you asked. Only the board.
ask.paused: No connection. Your answer is waiting here and will go out when the network is back: don't close the app.
ask.offline: No connection, so your answer didn't go out. Try again when you have signal.
ask.slow: The connection is very slow: your answer hasn't arrived yet.

queue.onList: You're on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the board will tell you.
queue.position: You're {{position}} on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the board will tell you.

gone.title: Nothing here
gone.body: This event is gone, or you can't see it yet. Go back and see what is on.

said.yesSub: Change it whenever you like, but say so early: the board is counting on you.
said.maybe: You said maybe. We're holding your place.
said.maybeSub: If it turns out you can’t, say so and the place goes to someone else.
said.noSub: If you change your mind, come back while there are places left.
said.nothingSub: Three taps and you're done. Maybe counts too.
said.requested: You've asked. The board still has to confirm it.
said.requestedSub: Don't buy tickets yet. We'll tell you in the group once it's decided.
said.refusedSub: There were more people than beds. Ask again if anything changes.

event.lastOneSub: This won't last half an hour.

gimcana.title: The scavenger hunt
gimcana.closed: Nothing shows until the party starts. It closes when the party ends.
gimcana.gone: That challenge isn't there any more.
gimcana.tryAgain: That one didn't count. Have another go.
gimcana.rule: Anybody on the team can do any challenge. One challenge, one photo: the first one that counts, scores.
gimcana.boardLead_one: It moves when the board approves. Right now there's {{count}} photo in the queue.
gimcana.boardLead_other: It moves when the board approves. Right now there are {{count}} photos in the queue.
gimcana.boardLeadEmpty: It moves when the board approves.
gimcana.boardEmpty: Nothing approved yet. The first photos are already in the queue: this will move shortly.
gimcana.boardNote: The scoreboard is for tonight only: it doesn't touch the year's ranking. If the winning team gets something, you decide that at the party.
gimcana.takePhoto: Take the photo or pick one from your camera roll
gimcana.sendNote: Somebody on the board looks at it the same night. The points land when they say it counts.
gimcana.offlineNote: It works with no signal too: it's saved and sent by itself when the network comes back.
gimcana.queued: Saved. It'll send itself when the network comes back — you can close the app.
gimcana.notSaved: The photo couldn't be saved. Try again, or pick another one.
gimcana.noTeamQueued: Saved. It will go by itself once the board puts you in a team.
gimcana.wrongTeam: Wrong team? Tell someone on the board: they can move you.

wait.title: The board has to put you in a team
wait.lead: When they do, your team and the challenges will show up here. You don’t need to do anything: this screen updates by itself.

rejected.title: That one didn't count
rejected.noReason: You can send another photo: the challenge is still open.

pick.title: Who are you playing with?
pick.lead: Pick a team. You can change it until you send something.
pick.full: That team is full. Pick another one.
pick.changeTitle: Which team do you want to join?
pick.alreadySent: You’ve already sent a photo with your team. Only the board can move you now.
pick.changed: The teams changed while you were looking. Try again.

cta.unknown: We can't tell if you're going.

rank.nudge: Nobody above you is slowing down.
rank.comeback: Your best streak is {{best}}. The first one you come to starts another.

recap.title: Last time
recap.were_one: {{count}} was there and we still laugh about it
recap.were_other: {{count}} of us were there and we still laugh about it

upcoming.title: What else is coming
upcoming.thatIsAll: And after that, nothing yet. Relax, something will turn up.
upcoming.none: Nothing else on the calendar yet. Relax, something will turn up.

empty.title: Nothing right now
empty.body: There's nothing on the calendar. Relax, something will turn up.

inside.lede: The ones who checked in. Each from their own phone on arrival, or with the scanner when the phone couldn't.
inside.ledePast: The ones who checked in at the door.
inside.note: The faces are a sample. The number in the middle is the real count.

checkin.title: Are you there?
checkin.lede: Check in from right here. It looks at where you are, and if you're at the place, that's it: nobody has to scan anything.
checkin.doneNoPoints: Checked in. You already had tonight’s points.
checkin.far: You're {{metres}} m from the place. If you really are there, it's the GPS: try stepping outside for a moment, or tell the board and they'll add you by hand.
checkin.closed: Check-in isn't open yet, or it's over.
checkin.noPlace: This event has no place on the map yet. Tell the board and they'll set it in a moment.
checkin.gone: This event isn't there any more.
checkin.queued: No signal. We wrote it down with the time and the place you're at now, and it'll go on its own when the network comes back.
checkin.photoNote: Optional, and only you and the board see it. Take it and you get the diptych with the one on the way out.

nofix.denied: You aren't letting us see where you are. Your browser settings can give this page location permission — Settings › {{app}} › Location — and then come back, or tell the board and they'll add you by hand.
nofix.unavailable: The phone can't work out where it is. Stepping outside for a moment or turning the GPS on usually fixes it.
nofix.timeout: That took too long. Try again.
nofix.unsupported: This browser can't tell where you are. Tell the board and they'll add you by hand.

failed.lluny: The check-in from {{dia}} couldn't be validated: you were {{metres}} m from the place. No points were added.
failed.tancat: The check-in from {{dia}} couldn't be validated: it arrived outside the window. No points were added.
failed.noHiEs: The check-in from {{dia}} couldn't be validated: you weren't on the list. No points were added.
failed.senseLloc: The check-in from {{dia}} couldn't be validated: the event had no place set. No points were added.

exitPhoto.noFrame: The camera hasn't given a picture yet. Give it a second and try again.
exitPhoto.entryAlt: The photo from when you came in

entrada.title: However you're arriving
entrada.note: Only you and the board see this one, and they use it to work out who came in. Take the one on the way out too and you get the diptych.

sortida.title: However you are right now
sortida.note: Nobody else sees this photo. Not the board, not the group, not the ranking: it goes in your profile and the diptych is yours to look at.

camera.denied: We can't open the camera. Give it permission in your browser settings — Settings › {{app}} › Camera — and come back, or leave it: the photo is optional and you're already checked in.
camera.missing: This device has no camera. You're checked in all the same; the photo is what you miss.
camera.failed: The camera wouldn't start. Try again, or leave it: you're already checked in.

diptych.title: Your nights
diptych.worseOut: You come out worse than you went in. That's the whole point.
diptych.stillTime: Still time: you can take it whenever, two weeks from now included. Different jumper, same idea.
diptych.takeExit: Take the one on the way out
diptych.nobodyElse: Nobody else sees these two photos: not the board, not the group. If you share it, you share it.
diptych.forgetExit: Delete the one on the way out
diptych.noNights: You haven't checked in at a door yet. When you do, the night shows up here.

neither.title: No photos from that night
neither.body: The board had the door camera off that day, and you never took the one on the way out. You were there all the same.
neither.nextTime: Next time you can take the way-out one even without the door one: the diptych then shows your arrival time instead of the picture.

diptych.staysHere: There's no deadline: you can take it whenever you like.

exitCard.title: The way out is missing
exitCard.body: You took the arrival one at {{titol}}. The way-out one is yours to take now, and the diptych is yours alone.
exitCard.bodyWithTime: You checked in at {{titol}} at {{hora}}. The way-out one is yours to take, and the diptych is yours alone.

share.nothingAuto: Nothing gets posted on its own. You decide, every time.
share.downloadNote: This phone can't share images from the browser. It's in your photos and you post it.

gallery.title: The photos
gallery.whoCanUpload: Anybody who checked in that night can add photos.
gallery.thumbsNote: Tap a photo to see it full size.
gallery.uploadNote: They upload one at a time. Keep the screen open until it finishes; anything that fails stays here.

empty.title: No photos from this night yet
empty.yours: You were there. The first one is yours if you want it.
empty.theirs: They come from whoever checked in. When there are some, you'll see them here.

report.title: What is wrong with this photo?
report.hi_surto: I'm in it and I don't want to be
report.note: The board sees it and takes it down if needed. Whoever added it won't know you asked.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.lede: What to do on the days when nothing is on. The board looks at whichever has most votes.
ideas.mineLede: Only you see this. Nobody else knows yours was turned down.
ideas.privateNote: A turned-down idea is on nobody else's list. Not even the title.
ideas.withdrawNote: You can delete it while nobody has backed it.
ideas.emptyTitle: Nothing here yet. Go on, say it
ideas.emptyLede: If nobody says anything, nothing happens: that's what the weeks between events do.
ideas.emptyPick: Start with one of these, if you like
ideas.emptyPickNote: Tap one and it goes in the title. You can change it after.
ideas.emptyFoot: It doesn't have to be good: people will vote. And if it goes ahead, {{points}} for whoever said it.
ideas.failedSub: We don't know how many there are. That isn't the same as none.
ideas.failedVotesSub: We don't know what you had backed either. Nothing is touched until it loads.
ideas.newLede: Two things and that's it. We can talk about the details later.
ideas.newBodyPlaceholder: Where, when and what is needed. Four words will do.
ideas.newPublic: It goes up with your name and your face, and everybody in the comi can vote for it.
ideas.newPaid: If the board turns it into an event, {{points}} for you.
ideas.juntaLede: The same list everybody sees, with two more buttons.
ideas.whyNotPlaceholder: Whoever proposed it will read this, and nobody else.
ideas.noEvents: An event has to exist already before an idea can become one.
ideas.alreadyDecided: Somebody else has already decided it.
ideas.whyNotNote: It can't be turned down without a reason: that sentence is the whole of what the person receives, and it's the difference between them proposing another one and never proposing again.
ideas.queuedOffline_one: {{count}} idea saved, it goes up when there's signal
ideas.queuedOffline_other: {{count}} ideas saved, they go up when there's signal

install.title: Put it on your screen
install.lede: Two taps and it behaves like a real app: it opens instantly, the QR works with no signal, and you don't sign in again every time.

step1.title: Tap Share
step1.body: It's the little square with the arrow pointing up. Depending on the iPhone it's in the bottom bar or the top one, next to the address. If you can't see it, tap the three dots.

step2.title: Look for “Add to Home Screen”
step2.body: Scroll the list; on some iPhones it's under “More”. Then tap Add.

payoff.title: What you get
payoff.body: Your QR first try, without hunting for it and even with no signal. Full screen, no browser bar. And the session stays put.

install.laterWarning: You can carry on here in the browser. Once you add it to your home screen you'll sign in one more time, because the iPhone treats them as two separate things.
install.iconPreview: This is how it will sit among your apps. The red icon is easy to spot when you're in a hurry.

opened.title: Now open it from the icon
opened.body: You can close Safari now. Open the app from its icon on your home screen and sign in there: that's where your session stays.
opened.stay: I'd rather stay in the browser

card.title: Put it on your home screen
card.body: Two taps in Safari and it opens instantly, full screen, with your QR ready even without signal.
card.again: When you open it from the icon, sign in once more with Google using the same account. The iPhone keeps the app and Safari apart, but the account is the same one.

android.lede: One tap and it's on your home screen: full screen, the QR to hand, and no browser in the way.

junta.title: Board area
junta.needsSignalBody: It isn't on your phone yet, and it can't be downloaded without signal. The door works offline.
junta.newEventSub: Or copy an earlier one and change the date
junta.invitesSub: The group code and who wants in
junta.paymentsSub: Who has paid, who has asked for a place and the waiting list
junta.noEvents: Nothing on the calendar yet. Create the first one.
junta.youAreAdmin: You're an admin: you can create events, check people in, give points and name other admins.
junta.youAreOwner: You're the owner: on top of what an admin does, you can remove admins and hand over the owner role.

extern.title: From outside
extern.isExtern: Marked as from outside: no school, and counts for none.
extern.isNot: If they're not at any of the three schools, mark them here. Their school, degree and year are cleared, and their points stop counting for the school.
extern.unmarkHint: Next time they open the app they'll have to pick a school.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.oneCode: One code per group, that's all. If it leaks, kill it and make another.
invites.shareText: Join the comi: {{link}} — the code is {{code}}. Sign in with Google and you're done.
invites.killAndRemake: Kill this code and make another
invites.killExplains: Anybody already in stays in. It only stops working for new people.
invites.killSure: The code pasted in the group stops working immediately. Whoever is already in stays in.
invites.none: There's no active code right now. Nobody can get in by invitation.
invites.askFirst: If you don't know the name, ask the group before letting them in. Better to take a day than to have strangers in the ranking.
invites.letInDone: {{name}} is in. They can join with the code.
invites.rejectDone: {{name}} doesn't get in. They aren't told anything.

payments.title: Payments and board
payments.bizum: The money still moves the way it always has. This is only so nobody ends up keeping a spreadsheet on their phone.
payments.free: This one is free. There's nothing to collect.
payments.nobody: Nobody has signed up yet. They appear here once they say yes.
payments.notInList: This event is no longer on the board's list. Pick one from the selector above.
payments.chaseThem: Anyone still unpaid on Friday morning, message them yourself. The group chat doesn't work.
payments.queueSub: In the order they joined. If a place frees up, you decide who takes it.
payments.requestsSub: Nobody has one until you say yes. Anybody you don't confirm stays waiting — that isn't the same as being told no.
payments.refuseSure: Saying no takes {{nombre}} off the list for good. Confirming doesn't send them anything.
payments.noRoomLeft: No places left. Raise the cap on the event form if you want to fit one more.
payments.gone: That person is no longer asking.

abastSub.junta: It appears on nobody's Home. Members can't see it even with the link, and it gives nobody points or streak.
abastSub.comi: It appears on everybody's Home, under the parties, and everyone can say whether they will be there.

form.pointsMeetingHint: They're given when you close the meeting, not when people confirm: whoever says they'll be there and isn't, earns none.
form.meetingHasNo: A meeting has no places, no price, no cover and no cars
form.meetingHasNoSub: Those fields disappear from the form rather than sitting there empty. If you picked the wrong kind, go back and they come back exactly as they were.
form.coverEmpty: Tap to add the cover photo
form.coverHint: Landscape, with people in it. That's what makes people tap through.
form.name: What it is called
form.what: What kind of thing it is
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What there will be, who is playing, what to bring
form.transportHint: Always write this. It's the question the group asks most.
form.transportPlaceholder: The last train, the night bus, who is driving
form.revealSub: Publish it covered: until the time you set, people see the teaser and the countdown.
form.teaserHint: Enough to intrigue and no more. Explain it and there's nothing left to reveal.
form.teaserPlaceholder: Keep the weekend of the 14th free
form.previewNoDate: Set a time and it opens by itself
form.previewHiddenFields: The place, the description, the cover and getting home: hidden until then.
form.publishNow: It appears on everyone's Home straight away.
form.publishHidden: It opens by itself at the time you set. Nothing else to do.
form.saveChangesNote: It's already on everyone's Home: the change shows straight away.
form.liveSub_one: {{count}} person can see it right now.
form.liveSub_other: {{count}} people can see it right now.
form.liveSubPlain: The whole comi can see it right now.
form.draftSub: Nobody but you can see it.
form.unpublishAsk: Unpublish it and it disappears from everyone’s Home. Anyone already signed up stays signed up.
form.deleteAsk: Sure? It goes for good, along with everyone who signed up. This can't be undone.
form.deleteHasPoints: This one has points on it and can't be deleted: the points would be left with nothing to say where they came from. Unpublish it and it disappears from everyone’s Home.
form.previewLive: This is what the comi will see
form.previewCovered: This is what the comi will see until it opens
form.confirmHint: Tick this and signing up becomes asking: nobody has a place until the board confirms it, one by one. Ticked by default for a country house.
form.confirmOn: The board decides who gets in
form.confirmOff: Signing up gives you a place straight away
form.carsHint: Tick this and the shared-cars block appears on the event. Ticked by default for a country house; untick it if people can walk.
form.coverFailed: The cover image wouldn't upload; the event was saved without it. Try again whenever you like.
form.endsBeforeStarts: The end is before the start.
form.endsRequired: The end time is missing. It's where the report hours come from.
form.revealAfterStarts: The reveal is after it starts: it would uncover nothing.

eines.title: Tools for this event
eines.lede: They all belong to this event. The door on the junta home is just a shortcut.
eines.ledeDraft: This is a draft: the scanner, check-in by name, points and payments appear once you publish it.
eines.ledeMeeting: A meeting has no door: whoever closes it says who was there.
eines.soon: The scanner and check-in by name open thirty hours before it starts.
eines.closed: The scanner and check-in by name close seven days after it ends. Points can always be given.

escaner.title: The scanner
escaner.sub: Reads the QR code of whoever comes in.

alta.title: Check in by name
alta.sub: For anyone without their QR code to hand.

punts.title: Give points
punts.sub: For work done, the day after too.

legal.privacySub: What we hold, who sees it, how long it stays.
legal.acceptNote: By carrying on you accept how we handle your data.

privacyBody.lead: This app holds your name, your face and where you go on a Friday. It is worth knowing what is in there and who sees it, so here it is without the padding.

who.title: Who answers for this
who.p1: The data here is the responsibility of {{entity}}, tax number {{taxId}}, at {{address}}. Not of whoever built the app.
who.p2: For anything on this page, write to {{contact}}. That is where it actually arrives, and the board reads it.

identity.title: Who you are
identity.p1: You sign in with your Google account, and from there we take your name, your email and your profile picture. You then add your school, degree, year and phone number. Name and picture you can change whenever you like.
identity.p2: Your name, picture, school, degree and year are visible to every active member. That is on purpose — this is an association, not a mailing list — but you are better off knowing than finding out.

contact.title: Your email and phone
contact.p1: Your email is seen by you and by the board. Your phone likewise, with one exception: if you get into somebody's car, that driver sees your number in case they have to wait for you. The other passengers do not. The screen tells you before you get in.

going.title: Where you say you are going
going.p1: When you say you are going to something, you appear on the list of who is going. When you come through the door, the exact time and whether you have paid are recorded too, and any member can see that.
going.p2: Added up, that is a calendar of your nights out, and any member can read it. You can take yourself off the ranking from your profile: you then do not appear on the list, but your points still count towards your school and, since attendance lists are open, it is no way of hiding them.

photos.title: Photographs
photos.p1: There are three kinds and they are not seen alike. The door photo is seen by you and by the board; the leaving photo only by you, and you can delete it; a night's gallery is seen by every member.
photos.p2: None of them is public on the internet: every one is fetched through a link that expires within the hour. Before upload the metadata is stripped, meaning the phone model and any location recorded in the file.
photos.p3: If you do not like a photo of yourself, you can report it from the photo itself and the board takes it down. Whoever posted it will see that it is gone, but not who asked.

where.title: Where you were when you checked in
where.p1: If you check in from your phone instead of the QR code, the phone sends where you are so we can tell you are at the venue. The coordinate is stored, but nobody sees it through the app: the board only sees how many metres from the venue you were, which is what it takes to spot somebody checking in from home.

travel.title: If you stay overnight
travel.p1: When an event is at a country house or other accommodation, the law requires the house to send the police the details of everyone who stays (Spanish RD 933/2021): name, surnames, sex, ID, nationality, date of birth and address. If you go, we ask you for them, plus an emergency phone number. We never ask for a photo of your ID.
travel.p2: You and the board see them; the board passes them on to the accommodation, and every time it opens them, who and when is logged. They delete themselves a week after the stay, or sooner if you stop going or leave the association. They are not kept for next time: each stay asks for them again. That is what the app does; the copy the board exports to send to the accommodation is the board's responsibility, and it must delete it once sent, while the accommodation keeps its own for as long as the law requires.

log.title: The board's log
log.p1: Everything the board does — awarding points, admitting somebody, publishing an event — is recorded with who did it and when. The board reads that log and it deletes itself after two years.
log.p2: There is also a screen where the board sees who has not been around for a while, worked out from recent activities. It is good for nothing except writing to you and asking whether everything is all right.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.p1: As things stand, plainly: apart from the log and traveller details, nothing deletes itself. Not the profile, not the phone number, not the photographs, not the history. If you leave you stop appearing everywhere, but the data stays until somebody removes it by hand.
keep.p2: It is something we want to fix before this grows, and in the meantime we will not quote you a deadline we do not meet.

others.title: Who else touches it
others.p1: The database and the photographs live on Supabase, on servers in Ireland. The page is served by Cloudflare. Google is the front door when you sign in, and since your profile picture comes from their server, Google knows when you open the app.
others.p2: If you turn on notifications, the message travels encrypted through your browser's push service — Google, Apple, Mozilla or Microsoft, depending on the phone — which sees that something reached you but not what it said.
others.p3: There is no analytics, no advertising, and no other third-party script of any kind. We sell nothing to anybody because there is nothing to sell.

minors.title: If you are not 18 yet
minors.p1: From the age of 14 you can give permission for this data yourself, and therefore to use the app. The parental authorisation we ask for on certain activities is a different thing and goes a different way: on paper, separately.
minors.p2: The app does not ask your date of birth (except in the traveller details for a place to stay, which delete themselves) and checks no age. If you are under 18 and would rather your face did not appear in a night's gallery, say so and it will not.

rights.title: What you can ask for
rights.p1: You can see and change your profile in the app, take yourself off the ranking, delete your leaving photo and leave the association. That works on its own and takes effect at once.
rights.p2: For anything else — a copy of everything we hold about you, a correction, or deletion — write to {{contact}}. There is no button for it yet: a person does it by hand, which is why it can take a few days.

changes.title: If this changes
changes.p1: If we change anything here, we will say so in the group. We do not use your data for anything this page does not describe.

termsBody.lead: Not much, and no small print. This is a student association's app, run by four people between lectures, and the rules are the ones you were already expecting.

what.title: What this is
what.p1: An app for seeing what is on, signing up, getting through the door and keeping an eye on the ranking. It is not a service we have sold to anybody and we charge nothing for it.

who.title: Who can join
who.p1: You need an invitation from the board. Until they admit you your account is pending: you can see what is on, but you cannot sign up for anything. If you leave the association the board marks you as having left and you stop appearing on the lists.

you.title: What we expect of you
you.p1: Your QR code is yours: hand it to somebody and they come in under your name and you keep the points. Do not do it.
you.p2: In the gallery, do not post photographs of people who would rather not be in them. It is the usual rule at a party, written down.
you.p3: And what you write in ideas and comments is read by everyone in the comi, with your name next to it.

points.title: Points
points.p1: You earn them by turning up and helping: checking in at the door, driving people, setting up, proposing an idea that ends up happening. The board or the door awards them, and the points table is public in the board area.
points.p2: If somebody gets it wrong, it gets corrected. Points are not bought and do not move from one person to another, and the ranking runs by academic year: when a new one starts, it goes back to zero.

junta.title: What the board can do
junta.p1: Admit and remove members, publish and delete events, correct points, take a photograph down, and close a meeting with its minutes. All of it is recorded in the log with the name of whoever did it.

moderation.title: If a photograph should not be there
moderation.p1: Every gallery photograph has a button to ask for it to be looked at. You can say that you are in it and would rather not be, or that there is something else wrong with it.
moderation.p2: The board looks and decides. If they take it down it disappears for everybody at once, and it can be undone if it was a mistake. Whoever posted it sees that it is gone; whoever asked does not appear anywhere.
moderation.p3: No deadline is promised. There are four of them, and the honest commitment is that they look when they see it, not that they look within twenty-four hours.

stop.title: If you leave
stop.p1: Tell the board and they will mark you as having left. You stop appearing on the lists and in the ranking. What already happened — the points from a party, the photographs of a night — stays, because it belongs to everybody who was there and not only to you.

noguarantee.title: This is not a product
noguarantee.p1: The app can fall over on the night of a party, a notification can fail to arrive, and one day it can stop existing. We cannot promise you it will always work. If something goes wrong there is the door, a notebook and somebody writing names down, the way there always was.

meeting.closeCta: Close it and give the points
meeting.closeAgain: It can be reopened until the term ends. Every change goes into the log.

meeting.juntaOnly: Board meetings are only visible to you.

onboarding.title: You're in
onboarding.lede: Five things and you're in. We already have your name and photo from Google — check they look right.
onboarding.ledePending: Five things and you're all set. We already have your name and photo from Google; the board has to accept you before you can sign up for anything.
onboarding.nameHint: If it isn't your real name, change it in your profile: the board has to find you on the list.

school.label: Your school
school.lede: Your points go to your school. The three of them compete all year.
school.foraHint: I'm not at any of the three schools. My points count for me and that's it.

degree.label: Degree
degree.listFailed: We couldn't load the list of degrees. Carry on and add it later from your profile.

phone.label: Phone
phone.why: Only so we can add you to the WhatsApp group. It doesn't appear on your profile, and only the board sees it.
phone.invalid: That number doesn't look right. Leave it blank if you would rather not.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.why: So people can follow you. This one does show on your profile and other members see it.
instagram.invalid: That isn't a username. Letters, numbers, full stop and underscore only, and not the whole address.

cta.pickSchoolPending: Pick your school and carry on
cta.pickSchool: Pick a school and you're in
cta.fix: Check the phone or the Instagram

onboarding.later: You can change all of this later in your profile.

badges.title: Badges
badges.lead: You earn them by doing things, not by asking. Nobody can hand you one.
badges.leadEmpty: None yet, and that's where everybody starts. They all come from turning up: the first one lands on day one.
badges.stripEmpty: None yet. The first one lands the first day you come.
badges.footerGrid: The ones you're missing tell you how they are earned. None counts down, none expires.
badges.footer: A badge you've earned never goes away, even if you stop meeting the condition.

primera.title: The first one
primera.about: The day you walked through a door and it was recorded. No other badge can come before this one.
primera.won: There's a first time now. It stays on your profile.

activitats.title: Five, ten, twenty-five
activitats.done: Events you have turned up to
activitats.about: Events you have turned up to. One badge that levels up: there's no set of three to collect.
activitats.won: One more event that counts. It stays on your profile.

capDeSetmana.title: Weekend away
capDeSetmana.about: A country house isn't a night, it's two days with the same people. The only badge that asks you to pack.
capDeSetmana.won: First weekend away. It stays on your profile.

deTot.title: A bit of everything
deTot.about: Party, country house and activity. The comi does three very different things, and this says you have tried all three.
deTot.won: You've done all three kinds of plan. It stays on your profile.

alVolant.title: Behind the wheel
alVolant.about: You offered seats and somebody took them. An empty offered car doesn't count: what this recognises is having driven people.
alVolant.won: You drove people there. It stays on your profile.

aMuntar.title: Setting up
aMuntar.hint: Come and help set an event up
aMuntar.about: You turned up before anybody else to do the part nobody sees. The board awards it with the set-up points.
aMuntar.won: You came to set up. It stays on your profile.

copilot.title: Passenger
copilot.about: You rode in somebody else’s car. Car sharing works when both halves show up, and this is the other one.
copilot.won: You shared a car. It stays on your profile.

vaSerIdeaMeva.title: That was my idea
vaSerIdeaMeva.hint: An idea of yours that goes ahead
vaSerIdeaMeva.done: An idea of yours, taken up
vaSerIdeaMeva.about: You suggested something and the board took it up. Of all the badges, this is the one that leaves the most behind.
vaSerIdeaMeva.won: Your idea is going ahead. It stays on your profile.

entradaISortida.title: In and out
entradaISortida.about: The face arriving and the face leaving, from the same party. The diptych is yours and the board can't see it.
entradaISortida.won: You have the whole diptych. It stays on your profile.

deLesPrimeres.title: Early on
deLesPrimeres.hint: Check in among the first five one night
deLesPrimeres.done: Among the first five to check in
deLesPrimeres.about: Among the first five to check in, and only at events with ten people or more. Turning up early when it matters.
deLesPrimeres.won: You checked in among the first five. It stays on your profile.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.body: So people recognise you. That's all.
photo.where: It shows in the ranking, in the list of who is going to each party, and at the door. So you're recognised at night and from a distance.
photo.google: Go back to the Google one
photo.clear: Take it off, leave the stripes

name.label: What you are called
name.hint: What people actually call you, not a nickname: the board has to find you on the payments list.
name.waiting: No signal. It saves itself when the network is back: no need to press again.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.hint: It shows on your profile so other members can follow you. Leave it blank if you would rather not.
instagram.invalid: That isn't a username. Letters, numbers, full stop and underscore only, and not the whole address.

locked.title: This isn't changed here
locked.why: Points go to your school, and changing it mid-year would move everybody's ranking. If it's wrong, write to the board.

breakdown.title: Where the points came from
breakdown.empty: No points yet. Come to something and this fills itself in.

avisos.title: Your warnings
avisos.lede: What the board recorded this year and why. A struck-through one has been withdrawn: it no longer counts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.public: Show me in the public ranking
settings.publicOn: You appear with your name and face.
settings.publicOff: You don't appear, but your points still count for your school.
settings.nightsSub: The in-and-out diptych from every party
settings.calendarSub_one: The one you said yes to, in one go
settings.calendarSub_other: The {{count}} you said yes to, in one go

signOutPending.warn_one: You have {{count}} thing still to send. Leaving now loses it.
signOutPending.warn_other: You have {{count}} things still to send. Leaving now loses them.

streak.title: Your streak

none.label: no streak going
none.sub: It starts at the first one you come to.

streak.note: Only events you could have come to count. A waiting list never breaks it.

broken.title: The streak stopped at {{n}}
broken.body: Those {{n}} stay as your best. The next event starts another one, the same for everybody.

streak.atStake: You're on {{n}} in a row. This one counts.

hores.title: Your hours
hores.label: hours this year
hores.empty: None yet. What counts is what happens at the university: set-ups, fairs, workshops and board meetings.
hores.note: Only what happens at the university counts towards the end-of-year report. The board signs the hours off once the activity is over.
hores.signed: The board signs the hours off once the activity is over.

gone.title: This member is no longer here
gone.body: A profile stops being visible when somebody leaves the comi. What they did stays in the board's log.

member.footer: This is what any member sees of you. Your phone number and your exit photos aren't here.
member.juntaSheetSub: Ledger, adjustments and warnings. Only the board sees it.

standing.hidden: They have asked to stay out of the ranking, so their points aren't shown here.

badges.empty: None yet. The first one lands on day one.

nights.title: Where they have been
nights.empty: Not down for any activity yet.

pending.title: The board has to let you in
pending.body: Signing in with Google tells us who you are. Being part of the comi is another thing, and somebody on the board has to say so.
pending.cannot: Sign up, have a QR, earn points
pending.haveCodeHint: With a code you're in at once. Without one, somebody on the board has to approve you by hand.
pending.codeBody: The one the board hands out in the group. Enter one and you're in.
pending.codeBad: That code doesn't work. Ask the board for another.
pending.note: Places, replies and points open up once the board accepts you.

qr.offlineOk: Brightness up · works with no signal
qr.howTo: The fallback: if you can't check in from your phone, show this at the door and wait for the “checked in”. Open this screen once with a connection and the code stays saved on your phone.
qr.unavailable: We can't show your code right now. Try once with a connection and it'll be saved for next time.
qr.fallback: Whoever is on the door can look you up by name.
qr.noneSaved: This phone has no QR saved: it has to be opened once with a connection. At the door they can look you up by name.

notYet.heading: My QR
notYet.lead: It's what you show at the door.
notYet.title: You haven't got one yet
notYet.pending: Once the board accepts you, your QR will be here.
notYet.left: This account is no longer active. If you think that's a mistake, talk to the board.

ranking.schoolsLede: Everything you do counts for your school, whether you are 3rd or 60th.
ranking.cutOff: That's as far as the list goes. If you can't see yourself, you need to get out more.
ranking.nothingYet: Nobody has any points yet. The first event gets it started.

rides.title: Lifts
rides.drivingPays: Bringing people in your car is worth {{points}}. It's the only way to score that doesn't go through the bar.
rides.lede: Whoever wants a lift. You can sort the petrol out between you.
rides.timeOdd: That's after the party starts. Sure?
rides.timePast: That time has already gone. Sure?
rides.notesPlaceholder: If you smoke in the car, if the boot is full, if you're coming back Sunday afternoon… a few words.
rides.phoneNote: You'll see the number of whoever gets in, in case you have to wait five minutes. They don't see yours.
rides.phoneToDriver: If you get in, the driver sees your phone in case they have to wait. The other passengers don't.
rides.pointsLater: The {{points}} are for the people you take, and they go on when you're back.
rides.onlyOne: One so far. More will turn up, but this one is definitely going.
rides.beFirst: Be first and pick your seat. The other cars appear once there are people: it always goes that way.
rides.emptyLede: If you have a car, say so now: people sign up for the journey before they sign up for the house.
rides.emptyFoot: Bringing people is worth {{points}}, and you don't have to drink anything to earn them.
rides.failedSub: We don't know whether there are any, or whether you have a seat. Don't stay home over this.
rides.failedKeep: If you already had a seat, you still have it: nobody loses that.
rides.driverPhones: Only you see these numbers, and only for the people in your car. They don't see yours, or each other’s.
rides.withdrawSure: If you take it back, the {{count}} of them lose their seats. Tell them in the group yourself, and do it early, not on Friday.
rides.otherCar: You're already in another car going the same way. Get out of that one first.
rides.gone: That car is no longer there.
rides.holdNote: You hold the seat and they take it whenever they like.
rides.inviteNobody: Nobody left to invite: they're either already in a car, or they are you.
rides.yourSeat: A seat is being held for you
rides.yourSeatSub: {{who}} is holding you a seat. Take it if you're going.
rides.invitedOk: Seat held. Now it's their call.

action.okWalkinReview: Check they pay on the way in, or note it down.
action.okWalkinReviewFree: Places are capped. Note it down so the count adds up.
action.okWalkinReviewUnknown: Note it down so the board can square it up.
action.alreadyCheckedIn: They already came through. If they insist, look them up under check-in by name.
action.notAMember: Ask their name and find them by hand. Don't wave them through unrecorded.
action.memberInactive: Have them ask to join. Approve them tomorrow from the board area.
